text: {"node_claim": "Future technical optimizations in computer vision, such as intersectional error analysis, improve AI accuracy and robustness.", "relation": "argues_for", "reason": "The span directly states that future work should explore intersectional error analysis to improve dataset composition, feature selection, and neural network architectures, as cited in the point."}
